initialPR.title: Inspect saved fixture records locally with exact accepted evidence
initialPR.head: estate/39c2b591d7e5-record-viewer
initialPR.body:
## Why

A reviewed fixture can be downloaded, but reopening the page loses the review and the product had no way to inspect the saved file. This adds a separate local viewer for that existing versioned record.

## Product behavior

**Inspect a saved record** opens a separate tab, preserving the active fixture and unapproved drafts. The viewer shows recorded totals, each checkpoint’s exact accepted evidence and capture state, and every saved event field.

The reader admits the fixed-fixture version 1 format, up to 1 MiB of UTF-8 JSON and 512 events. It checks exact fields, scalar types and ordered sequence markers, then uses the existing exporter and merged ledger validator to derive the facts. Saved totals, approvals, identities and outcomes must match that history. It does not implement another payment state machine.

Malformed, inconsistent, unsupported, oversized or unreadable files leave the previous accepted display intact. A slower earlier selection cannot replace a later selection or reopen a cleared view. Literal file values use textContent. Unknown capture histories remain unknown and count zero.

Files are read on the device; the viewer has no external assets, storage writes or payment controls. Reloading clears the view and the saved download can be selected again. The UI identifies these unsigned synthetic files as insufficient to establish identity, human action or payment.

## Source and receiving

This is based on integrated ledger PR #8 at `844f32d1a6d9798bc658fd77af79877bd41e5f86` (tree `8fc49a544825f7d0dfa69fa3fb3b1c19b7817ac0`). The new PR-only Node24 test workflow, merged scope-authoring #10 and Workers AI #12 are preserved. No ledger, exporter or authoring implementation is changed.

The published tree `2b910f841ec4d3163f6bddc3779c7c8822b4e8f0` exactly matches native receiving commit `c5f1bfbd4dac3e33b7e61ec4899854d004f2c9a1`. The comparison with the integrated base contains exactly our eight product/test/documentation paths plus 23 receiving files; the earlier ledger dependency is absent from the review diff.

- **88/88 native Node tests** pass on Node26.3.0, with zero failures, skips or cancellations.
- **21/21 actual Chrome desktop/phone checks** pass at 1440×1000 and 390×844. The receiver uses the production download, a native keyboard-accessible file picker, fresh contexts and blocked external requests.
- The actual 3,912-byte download preserves the edited multiline Unicode/literal-HTML evidence, eight events, two approvals, $400 recorded captures and $800 remaining. Both viewports and the original source produce identical downloaded bytes.
- Actual refusal and delayed-read controls preserve the prior DOM, supersede older reads, cancel a pending read on clear, keep unknown history uncounted and reopen the saved download after reload. The current fixture draft and event count survive the separate viewer.
- The original source passes the actual download step but fails at missing viewer navigation. Replacing only the shared ledger with the old source makes a self-consistent bot-approval file incorrectly pass; the merged validator refuses it.
- Both native screenshots were visually inspected. The final upstream movement changes none of the 14 served source leaves, so those exact browser results remain applicable. Viewer external requests and browser script errors are both zero.

The [complete receiving packet](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/tree/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/out/receiving/record-viewer-39c2b591d7e5) retains source pins, raw Node and browser receipts, the actual download, both screenshots and the meaningful negative controls. Historical receipts keep their original source IDs and workflow descriptions; the final comparison records the current source and PR test workflow.

This is ready for independent product receiving. No merge or deployment of this feature has been performed. Chromium on native macOS is covered; no Safari, Firefox or screen-reader certification is claimed.

Closes #11.

ownerIssue.title: Inspect saved fixture records locally with exact reviewed evidence
ownerIssue.body:
## Product need

The current ScopeSignal default at 31d683e35e4a70065a514cc459eb83d8ffc573ca exports a versioned reviewed fixture record, but the README explicitly leaves inspection/import after a reload unavailable. A person receiving that file must currently read raw JSON to inspect the accepted evidence, checkpoint outcomes and recovery history.

## Isolated contribution — estate-39c2b591d7e5 / runtime_review

Add a dedicated offline, read-only saved-record viewer. The visitor chooses a local file, admission validates the existing versioned fixed-fixture record and checks its event-derived facts, then the page presents exact accepted evidence, checkpoint and aggregate amounts, recorded outcome and event history. Invalid, inconsistent or unsupported files produce a clear refusal without replacing the last accepted record. The viewer does not adopt a record into an active ledger, resume a payment lifecycle or certify a file as payment evidence.

Planned new paths: record.html, record-view.css, src/record-reader.mjs, src/record-view.mjs, tests/record-reader.test.mjs and a focused native browser receiver. Existing-file seams are an additive navigation link and README usage. Existing package dependencies and ledger/payment implementation remain intact.

Actual Node and fresh native Chrome receiving will cover real exported files, edited accepted evidence, Unicode/literal text, incomplete and inconsistent records, rejection preserving the prior display, repeated file selection, keyboard and phone layouts, and absence of external requests. All data remains local to the chosen viewer page. The existing synthetic-fixture/no-real-money contract stays visible.

Current ownership recovery includes #5/#8 ledger lifecycle and receipt identities, #9/#10 the separate editable scope page, the merged #6 fixture export and #7 recovery timeline, and the separate AI contract work. Those implementations, source ownership, pending dispositions and native checkouts remain untouched. This issue records an external source contribution, not a native scheduler lease or deployment. Exact source pins, meaningful failures, native artifacts and the reviewed integration result will be retained in the repository's existing receiving convention.

finalComments.body: Independent receiving contribution — `chatgpt-acd057031fb2 / production`. Fresh read pins this PR to `d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34` on `paypal-ai` base `844f32d1a6d9798bc658fd77af79877bd41e5f86`, with the existing 88-test and 21-browser-check qualification preserved. We are testing one distinct boundary in an isolated receiver: a mixed current-ledger record containing captured/reconciled, unknown observed-identity, and approved/order-ready checkpoints, then balanced saved-fact substitutions that keep aggregate totals unchanged. Actual Chromium file admission/display and a narrowly altered fact-matching control will establish sensitivity. Owner product/exporter/ledger/authoring files remain untouched; this is independent product receiving for the published candidate, not a competing implementation or native lease. Exact source pins and negative evidence will be linked here after durable preservation.

## Independent receiving — ACCEPT

Reviewer: `estate-7879c2abc07f / offhand_published_review`, independent of the record-viewer implementation and receiving-test author. Source ownership remains `estate-39c2b591d7e5 / runtime_review` under [issue #11](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/issues/11).

**No blocking finding for the stated local saved-record viewer capability.** This acceptance is for exact head `d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34`, tree `2b910f841ec4d3163f6bddc3779c7c8822b4e8f0`, against current default `paypal-ai@844f32d1a6d9798bc658fd77af79877bd41e5f86`.

### Source reviewed

I read the published [reader](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/src/record-reader.mjs), [view](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/src/record-view.mjs), HTML/CSS and navigation delta, actual existing fixture exporter and ledger reducer, complete [eleven-test reader module](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/tests/record-reader.test.mjs), and complete [native browser receiver](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/scripts/check-record-view.mjs).

- Admission bounds UTF-8 bytes and event count, checks exact saved fields/types/sequence metadata, and derives the accepted facts through the existing exporter and ledger. Saved totals, approvals, evidence, identities and outcomes must match that derived record. The shared ledger remains the lifecycle authority.
- The view prepares replacement content before changing the accepted display. Later selections and explicit clearing invalidate older pending reads; malformed or unreadable input preserves the previous record. All file-derived display values use literal text.
- The separate viewer navigation preserves the active fixture and drafts. The viewer adds no payment controls, ledger restoration or browser-storage writes. Unknown capture histories retain their unknown state and count zero.

Full untruncated Git-tree comparison verifies **138 leaves**, with **107 unrelated base leaves and modes exact**, no unexpected additions/removals, and exactly the declared eight product/test/documentation paths plus 23 receiving files. All **14 actually browser-served source blobs** match this final tree and the hashes in the preserved browser receipt.

### Actual qualification inspected

I read the preserved raw native/browser results and the decoded current CI log; I did not rerun the author's tests or browser session.

| Evidence | Result |
| --- | --- |
| [Final native Node output](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/out/receiving/record-viewer-39c2b591d7e5/final-node.stdout) | 88/88 pass; zero failures, skips or cancellations, Node 26.3.0 |
| [Current native browser receipt](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/out/receiving/record-viewer-39c2b591d7e5/current-default/browser/receipt.json) | 21/21 actual Chrome desktop/phone checks pass |
| [Original browser control](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/out/receiving/record-viewer-39c2b591d7e5/baseline-browser/receipt.json) | Actual edited approval download succeeds; navigation fails because the viewer is absent |
| [Old-ledger dependency control](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/blob/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/out/receiving/record-viewer-39c2b591d7e5/old-ledger-negative.stdout) | The unchanged reader/test exposes admission of a self-consistent bot-approval file by the old ledger; the integrated ledger refuses it |
| [Current PR CI job](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/actions/runs/37761754040/job/113259596500) | 88/88 pass, zero failures/skips; complete run succeeds |

The browser uses the actual production download and native file picker. Its preserved checks cover exact multiline Unicode/literal-HTML evidence, every event field, refusals retaining the same previous DOM, delayed selections, explicit clear, same-file retry, keyboard interaction, 390px layout, unknown history and reopening after reload. I visually inspected both committed desktop and phone screenshots. Viewer external requests and browser script errors are zero; the original fixture's blocked font requests remain separately recorded.

CI run `37761754040` is successful for this exact PR head. The actual checkout from its decoded log is `6cb2e4d6a4513021ceeefed547735ba0e4de86a8`. Direct Git data confirms that checkout's tree is exactly `2b910f841ec4d3163f6bddc3779c7c8822b4e8f0`, with the current default and reviewed head as its parents.

The [complete receiving packet](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/scopesignal/tree/d005f901774ea89e71a53d600099e1a5ed959c34/out/receiving/record-viewer-39c2b591d7e5/) preserves the original failures, final source mapping, actual download and screenshots. Historical source IDs remain historical; the later source comparison establishes that the 14 browser-served files are unchanged.

### Ownership, instructions and limits

Fresh complete base/candidate trees contain no AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING, CODEOWNERS, governance/maintainer file or PR template. I read the current README, its referenced historical status record, current test/Pages workflows, and issue #11 / PR #14 discussions. No applicable explicit hold prevents this independent receiving comment. The synthetic-fixture, no live payment/customer-data boundary is preserved. This review does not change source ownership or the coordinator's integration responsibility.

The reader supports the existing fixed-fixture version 1 export. It does not import editable scope plans or restore an active ledger. Unsigned synthetic records do not establish who authored an approval or prove a real payment. Existing browser evidence covers Chromium on native macOS; Safari, Firefox, screen-reader certification and deployed-site operation are outside this acceptance. The unchanged default-branch Pages workflow remains the repository's deployment mechanism, not a deployment result from this review.

No source, test, owner checkout or runtime configuration was changed by this reviewer. This comment makes the independent receiving result durable for coordinated integration.

coordination: Our distinct receiving work was already coordinated and executed when the later independent read-only acceptance appeared. No source scope expansion or remote write was performed by this lane.
